name: calib_glossy
_why: Calibration: a rough metal wall reflecting one small bright emitter against black. This is the case SETTINGS.raytracing's glossy_reflection comment says the four-tap lobe fan cannot do -- a high-contrast point source is what turns too few taps into discrete ghost copies or an ordered dither, where a broad low-contrast floor (calib_mirror) hides both. The reflection is the ONLY light in the scene, so nothing else can mask it.
